system.description:
Favoured weapon: Flail, Heavy

Granted power: Advantage on saves vs weather and elemental effects. Once/day, when your Smite hits, lightning strikes the target for +3d6 lightning damage. No more than once on one Smite.

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Akadi in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: keep one road or sky-route open to all (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
